div.div: صُلَّاعٌ , (S, O, K,) or ↓ صُلَّعٌ , (K,) or the latter also, which is app. a contraction of the former, (S, O,) (assumed tropical:) Broad, (S, O, K, TA,) hard, (K, TA,) smooth, (TA,) rock: (S, O, K, TA:) n. un. (of the former, S, O, [and of the latter also,]) with ة. (S, O, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
